summary: Code quality is solid: TypeScript uses explicit types & async/await; bash script has `set -euo pipefail` & proper quoting; workflow uses pinned action refs & minimal permissions. However, critical gaps prevent shipping: (1) fixture directories (sample-data/, fixtures/) referenced by workflow env & run-act-tests.sh lines 38-40 are missing entirely; (2) actionlint validation is required per task but not shown as run; (3) act-result.txt artifact is required per task but not provided; (4) the `|| true` on aggregate-results step (line 160) masks test failures, suppressing exit code 1 from the aggregator. The run-act-tests.sh script cannot execute without fixture files. Fix: provide sample-data/ with .xml/.json fixtures, fixtures/ for default case, run actionlint, execute act test harness, and commit act-result.txt.
